newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKING-HUBER BADLY INJURED IN DOWNHILL CRASH.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKING-HUBER BADLY INJURED IN DOWNHILL CRASH.

text.p: German Berni Huber was badly injured in a spectacular high-speed crash during Saturday's men's World Cup downmhill.
Huber, who fell on the upper part of the Les Houches piste in the French Alps resort of Chamonix, was taken to a nearby hospital by helicopter.
He fractured an arm, several ribs and tore knee ligaments, his doctors said. He was undergoing surgery later.
